headline: Call to Economic Management from Tradespeople! They Have a Demand Regarding Special Consumption Tax (ÖTV)
summary: After successive price hikes, diesel's special consumption tax was reset to zero in August and set to rise to 3 lira in September and 6 lira in October. TESK has called for economic management.
why: Fuel taxes feed directly into transport and production costs, affecting inflation and businesses that rely on diesel.
